full_prompt_en: A square, densely drawn fantasy illustration arranges three horizontal story scenes inside narrow ornamental borders, using weathered blue, stone gray and vivid red. In the upper strip, a young dark-haired figure in a red cloak stands at the left foreground, looking across a crowded, ruined stone setting. Smaller people in warm garments fill the middle distance, while massive dark rock shapes and a pale animal-like head frame the right side. The middle strip moves closer to faces: an icy blue landscape occupies the far left, a large pale profile faces toward the center, and a red-haired woman in a gold-trimmed crimson hood looks to the right. Beyond her, a stern white-haired face emerges from the muted background. Across the bottom strip, a busy gathering of figures and creatures fills a stony interior, with a red-cloaked form near the center and darker faces anchoring both edges. Fine black contour lines describe hair, folds, stone and crowded decorative details, while transparent washes and small patches of color keep the intricate drawing from becoming flat. Red appears at intervals across all three levels, guiding the eye through otherwise cool and earthy passages. Light is broadly diffuse, with pale backgrounds and faces carrying the brightest values and recesses collecting blue-gray shadow. The strips read separately yet share the same narrow, elaborate linework and aged-paper tone. The overall composition feels like a richly illustrated narrative page, its crowded detail organized by horizontal rhythm and recurring crimson accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、线描繁密的奇幻插画，把三条横向故事场景置于窄窄的装饰边框内，使用磨旧的蓝色、石灰色和鲜明红色。最上条左侧前景，一名深发年轻人披红斗篷站立，望向拥挤而残破的石质场景。身穿暖色衣物的较小人物布满中景，巨大的深色岩形与一个浅色、近似动物的头部围住右侧。中间一条更贴近面部：冰蓝色地景位于最左，巨大的浅色侧脸朝向中心，一位红发女子戴着镶金边的深红兜帽，望向右侧。她的后方，一张神情严峻的白发面孔从压低的背景中浮现。底部一条中，人物和生物的热闹聚集填满石质室内，中心附近有披红斗篷的形体，两侧边缘则由较暗的面孔压住。纤细黑色轮廓线刻画头发、衣褶、石块与拥挤的装饰细节，透明色层和小块颜色又使精密线稿不至扁平。红色在三个层次间隔出现，引导目光穿过其他清冷或土色的段落。光线整体漫射，浅色背景和面孔承载最亮明度，凹处则积聚蓝灰阴影。三条场景各自可读，却共享窄密而繁复的线条与旧纸色调。整体构图如一页内容丰厚的叙事插画，拥挤细节由横向节奏和反复出现的深红强调组织起来。
style_prompt_en: The illustration pairs precise ink-like contours with layered, slightly weathered color washes. Delicate hatch marks and looping decorative lines make complex areas tactile, while wider pale passages allow the eye to rest. Cool mineral blues and grays dominate; aged cream, muted earth colors and recurring saturated crimson provide contrast and a clear visual path. Forms have firmly drawn outer edges but softer watercolor-like modeling within them. Light remains diffuse and relatively even, so value changes serve detail and hierarchy more than dramatic spotlighting. Repeated horizontal divisions and fine ornamental framing contain the visual density, giving the surface an antique, storybook richness without losing the major color rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 这类插画把精确的墨线式轮廓与略显磨旧的层叠薄彩结合。纤细排线与盘绕的装饰线令复杂区域具有触感，较宽的浅色段落则让视线休息。清冷矿物蓝与灰色占主导；旧奶油色、克制土色和反复出现的饱和深红形成对照，并建立清楚的视觉路径。形体外缘画得坚实，内部则由水彩式柔和塑形过渡。光线漫射且相对均匀，因此明暗变化主要服务于细节和层级，而非戏剧化聚光。重复的横向分隔与精细装饰边框收束视觉密度，让画面既有古旧故事书般的丰厚感，又不失主要色彩节奏。
theme_en: Three stacked illustrated fantasy scenes with red-cloaked travelers
theme_zh: 三条叠置的奇幻故事插画，出现身披红衣的旅行者
name: Jim Fitzpatrick
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
